column33: Approximately 6.8% of total revenues in Q2 2026 from international franchise segment, majority denominated in foreign currencies. Also operates dough manufacturing and distribution in Canada (CAD). Does not use financial instruments to hedge FX risk. 10% adverse FX move would reduce royalty revenues by ~$16.0M over two fiscal quarters of 2026.
column34: Purchases cheese and certain other food products subject to commodity price changes. May periodically enter into financial instruments to manage risk but has not done so historically. Uses fixed pricing agreements with suppliers accounted for as normal purchases.
column35: Exposed to interest rate risk on 2025 Variable Funding Notes (SOFR-based), but had no outstanding borrowings as of June 14, 2026. Fixed-rate debt exposes company to fair value changes and refinancing risk at potentially higher rates.
